datasets.title: Watersearch derived daily Johannesburg Water supply-status and outage history

provider.name: Watersearch
provider.publisher_statement: The API page states it is not run by Johannesburg Water or the City.

release.note: The API releases endpoint identified this release as the current response during review. The data page listed several distinct same-date releases and stated that bulk downloads were not yet built; pin one exact release for every future acquisition and do not mix same-date variants.

licence.publisher_declared: CC BY 4.0 for this compilation and its readings; credit Johannesburg Water as the source of the facts.
licence.provisionality_note: The API page says the licence is provisional until the site is public. The API/data pages were publicly accessible on 15 November 2026; recheck the licence and attribution terms at acquisition time.
licence.attribution_required: Watersearch for compilation/method; Johannesburg Water for reported board/notice facts.

api_contract.response_schema_note: The exposed OpenAPI document declares application/json response schemas as empty objects for the reviewed endpoints. Author and validate strict local schemas against pinned fixtures before use.

observation_semantics.reported_entity: named reservoir, tower, pump station or direct feed
observation_semantics.geography: suburb-to-supply links as reported by Johannesburg Water
observation_semantics.cadence: status boards usually appear twice daily; cadence is not guaranteed

no_report.meaning: no Johannesburg Water board was published for the named supply/day in the compiler's record

suburb_history.multiple_supply_rule: a suburb may depend on multiple linked supplies; assess together and preserve every supply row

observation_semantics.scheduled_closure_rule: scheduled overnight closures are reported separately and must not be counted as unplanned outage events

derived_outage_method.c41_gap_rule: Up to four consecutive days with no board between qualifying reports do not terminate a segmented outage. Those days remain counted in no_board_days and are never represented as observed no-water/critical reports.
derived_outage_method.censored_rule: censored=true means the compiler has no reported end. The reported end_at is the last qualifying report and duration is a lower bound, not an independently established restoration time.

lineage.duplicate_evidence_rule: Do not count Watersearch output as an independent source or second corroboration of the same underlying JW board or notice.

datasets.claim_ceiling: Versioned third-party compilation of Johannesburg Water's reported supply-board and notice statuses, and the compiler's explicitly documented derived daily/outage classifications.
does_not_establish: Water delivered at an individual household tap or customer connection.
Measured pressure, flow, reservoir volume, water quality or potable suitability.
Exact physical outage onset or restoration time.
Independent confirmation of a burst, repair, service restoration or affected customer.
An unplanned outage where only a scheduled closure is present.
A normal service state on a no_report day.
A verified service polygon from reported suburb-to-supply labels.
Leak ground truth, non-revenue water, saved water or operator intervention effectiveness.
A hydraulic boundary condition without a separate validated measurement source.

latest_report.source_wording: Poor pressure/ intermittent supply/ no water may occur in some areas

interpretation_limits: These are fields reported by the Watersearch API for a named reservoir; they are not a household/tap observation.
The 2026 days_bad value is paired with 228 reported days and must not be annualized to 365 without a missingness model.
A latest level of warned is a forward-looking warning statement, not an observed no_water/critical day.
The last-ten-outage duration summary includes a censored lower-bound interval; it is not a fully observed distribution.
The JSON response was reviewed via the public web interface, but exact response bytes were not downloaded, hashed, or saved as a source fixture.

interpretation_rules: This record is a third-party compilation of operator reporting, not a first-party Johannesburg Water source and not an independent witness.
Every acquired data row must bind exactly one immutable release_id and source_view.
Preserve raw JW status, compiler-normalized status, no_report, bypass and derived outage state as separate fields.
A no_report row is missing source reporting, not adequate service, zero outage, or zero demand.
A C41-bridged day is an unobserved gap included in a derived interval, not an observed no-water/critical day.
A censored outage duration is a lower bound only.
Never infer customer/tap service, hydraulic state or quality from a supply-board status.
Keep scheduled operating rules separate from unplanned outage segmentation.
Do not count the derivative as independent corroboration of its own underlying JW sources.
No SHA-256 or rights status is promoted until exact bytes are acquired and independently reviewed.
claim_ceiling: Metadata-only admission profile. The selected release payload, board/media bytes, exact data rights and any downstream service outcome remain unacquired/unqualified.
